scores.visual_critic_note: Controls are clean and typographically considered, but the circle-pack visualization is clipped at the bottom of the viewport and the dense dark edge bundles overwhelm the color-grouped circles, making the data encoding murky at the rendered size.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Area encoding is correct throughout — scaleSqrt for force-layout radii (line 533), scaleSqrt for sunburst radial scaling (line 683), and D3 pack's built-in area-correct layout; key functions present on all data joins; domains are data-driven via d3.extent; no bar/area baseline concerns apply to this topology visualization.
scores.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() before layout transitions allows the svg-level t.tween('render') tween and the force simulation tick to simultaneously mutate d.current_x/y when switching to force mid-transition, and there is no touch event filtering (e.g. !event.ctrlKey) on drag/zoom handlers.
scores.cognitive_load_note: The circle-pack hierarchy groups ~200 nodes into legible color clusters (3–4 hues visible), but the edge bundles at 8% tension converge into a dense dark tangle in the center that makes individual connections unreadable without hovering; animation-heavy layout-switching (1500ms flubber morphs across 8 layouts) cannot be assessed from a static screenshot.
